title: Bicha ke Farshe
body:
bicha ke farshe aza sayyeda ko yaad karo
lahoo bahao to zainnul liba ko yaad karo
dua e zainab o zehra hai majlis o matam
safe aza pe jo aao dua ko yaad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema aisi azadari karo
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ibadat hai na reh jaaye kahin is mein kami
shukr khaaliq ka karo tum ko banaya matami
majlis e shabbir se har dam wafadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e shabbir hai ilm o adab ki darsgaah
ye usi ki yaad mein hoti hai jo hai deen panah
shabbedari se aqeedon ki bhi bezaari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabr o eesaar o wafa ka ye bharam hai doston
ye alam abbas e ghazi ka alam hai doston
zehen mein ghazi ko rakho tab alamdari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e sarwar ke rutbe mein nahi koi sawaal
ho na paaye farshe matam ka taqaddus payemal
jaise padte ho namazein yun azadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum agar apne ko kehte ho azadar e hussain
dil se ban'na chaahte ho taziyadar e hussain
khatm kar do har siyasat bas azadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoora alam zainab ke haathon se saja
wo alam abbas ko de kar ye sarwar ne kaha
ay mere abbas tum lashkar ki salaari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar aun o mohamed ko ye zainab ne kaha
sar pe rakhlo tum amaame aur kamar baandho zara
apne mamu par fida hone ki tayyari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ultaf e aale mohamed majid apna hai nishan
unke gham mein muztarib unki khushi mein shadman
unke ban jao ghulam un se wafadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
author: Majid Raza Abidi
